description: This file contains serialization and deserialization functions for various JavaScript data types, including handling of complex objects, errors, typed arrays, and references, used within the Playwright protocol implementation.

methods.name: parseSerializedValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedValue into a JavaScript value, handling references, primitives, errors, typed arrays, and complex objects.

methods.name: serializeValue
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value into a SerializedValue, handling references, primitives, errors, typed arrays, and complex objects.

methods.name: serializePlainValue
methods.description: Serializes a plain JavaScript value into a SerializedValue without custom handle serialization.
